fusions.name: Lazy Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at the target, dealing 4 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and giving it a 30% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Inevitable Crush
fusions.desc: Crushes everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Settle In
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Build
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
